newsitem.title: UK: Life Assurance to buy part of UK business.
newsitem.headline: Life Assurance to buy part of UK business.

text.p: St. James's Place Capital Plc said on Friday its partly-owned Life Assurance Holding Corp Ltd agreed to buy part of Combined Life Assurance Co Ltd's UK life and pensions business.
Combined Life is a subsidiary of U.S. insurance company Aon Corp.
St. James has a 31.25 percent stake in Life Assurance.

Life Assurance also agreed to accept the transfer of the business into its operating unit, Windsor Life Assurance Co Ltd. The transfer would add a further 140 million stg to Windsor Life's funds under management, bringing the total to just under 2.0 billion stg, St. James said in a statement.
The transfer will not apply to Combined Life's accident, sickness, creditor, disability or critical illness business, the company said.
